t: Reservation price - Wikipedia
s: 3 weeks ago - In microeconomics, consumers set their reservation price as the highest price they are willing to pay for goods or a service, while sellers set the lowest price at which they would sell. Similarly, in finance, the reservation price—also called the indifference price—is the value at which an investor would be willing to buy (or sell) a financial security given his or her particular utility function.
